about_the_game:
Monsters You’ve Never Survived Before

Enter a new world of Eastern horror—brought to life in full VR.
Traditional Eastern zombies track you with terrifying precision, never stopping until you escape.
Prefer something more sinister? The museum is crawling with gargoyles, voodoo spirits, demons, elves, ghosts, mummies, and other nightmares—each designed with unique behaviors that force you to rethink how you move, hide, and survive in VR.

Death Is Just the Beginning

In Lost Soul: Escape the Doom Museum, dying doesn’t end your journey—it expands it.
When your body falls, your spirit rises. As a wandering soul, you can possess statues, artifacts, or even other mysterious beings to keep going.
Every death changes your perspective… literally.

Secrets Only the Dead Can Discover

Some rooms, puzzles, and hidden stories can only be found once you’ve crossed into the spirit world.
Certain passages appear only to souls. Some whispers in the dark only speak to the dead.
To uncover the truth behind the Doom Museum, you’ll need to embrace both life and death.

A Museum That Watches You Back

Run through a private museum packed with artifacts, relics, cursed idols, and occult objects from around the world.
Study the exhibits—if you dare. Read books left by previous visitors.
Every hallway tells a story, every statue has a secret, and every shadow might be alive.

Play Now — If You Dare

Possess, escape, hide, survive, and unravel the mysteries of the Doom Museum.
One wrong step… and you’re part of the exhibit forever.
